scope_note: OPERABILITY-axis spine for ai-agent-cli: deterministic artifact-presence mining over ['aider', 'gptme', 'openinterpreter'] — what mature neighbors ship AROUND the code. Advisory in check.py until this lens beats the generic-baseline control.

required.day1_tell: Build the container image from the repo's Dockerfile and run it.

required.aliases: continuous integration / github actions / build pipeline
required.day1_tell: Push a commit and confirm CI runs the test suite automatically.

required.what: Automates releases/publishing (tagged builds, changelog, registry push).
required.aliases: release workflow / publish pipeline / goreleaser / semantic release
required.day1_tell: Tag a version and confirm an automated release (artifact/registry/changelog) is produced.
Hit the health endpoint (or healthcheck command) and confirm it reports status.

required.what: Installable via standard packaging (not just git clone).
required.day1_tell: Install the tool through its package manager entry point and run the binary.

required.what: Ships a developer task entry point (make/just/task).
required.aliases: makefile / justfile / task runner / dev commands
required.day1_tell: Run the default dev task (e.g. `make test`) and confirm it works from a fresh clone.

required.aliases: install script / one-line install / setup script
required.day1_tell: Run the install script on a clean machine/container and confirm a working binary.

required.what: Supports users through breaking changes (upgrade guides / deprecation lifecycle).
required.aliases: upgrade guide / migration guide / deprecation policy
required.day1_tell: Follow the upgrade guide across one breaking version bump and confirm the documented steps work.

required.what: Instruments itself (metrics/traces/structured logs), not just prints.
required.day1_tell: Run the service and confirm metrics or traces are emitted to the configured sink.

required.what: Ships shell completions and/or man pages.
required.aliases: shell completions / man pages / cli ergonomics
required.day1_tell: Install the shipped shell completion (or open the man page) and confirm it works for the binary.

optional.aliases: docker compose / helm chart / kubernetes manifests
optional.day1_tell: Bring the stack up with one orchestration command (compose up or helm install).

optional.aliases: env example / sample config / configuration template
optional.day1_tell: Copy the shipped config example, fill the minimum values, and boot successfully from it.
Run the migration command against an old-schema database and confirm it upgrades cleanly.
Open the changelog and confirm the latest released version has an entry.
